facts.title: ProFrac (NASDAQ:ACDC) shares gap down
facts.takeaway: ProFrac reported a quarterly loss of $0.47 per share, $0.10 worse than estimates, on revenue of $449.6 million that beat expectations.

facts.title: ProFrac (ACDC) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
facts.takeaway: ProFrac shares rose 4.7% after Piper Sandler raised its price target to $6 from $5 with a Neutral rating, amid the energy rally tied to the Strait of Hormuz.
